utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m mostly trying to pin down the timing and who’s coordinating it, so I know when to expect people and who to check with.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — if you can confirm the time and who’s coordinating, I’ll double-check the rest and keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — that’d be a big help. If you can confirm the time and who’s coordinating, I can plan around it on my end.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — I’ll bring the wrench and screwdriver for the repair drive. Just let me know when you want me to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — swing by the community center on Maple. We’re starting there, and I’ll point you to the first fix.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll head to the community center on Maple and check in with you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I still haven’t heard which repair they’re starting with, but I’m asking around and will pass along anything solid right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep spreading the word and send the repair drive time, place, and first task as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out too, and once you hear the time, place, and first task, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ll check our supplies and set aside what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — that would help a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for Rosa’s update on the start time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll send you a quick update once I’ve sorted what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still on for the same time, and we could really use a few more hands for sorting and simple fixes. If folks can bring gloves, any extra tools, and maybe a table for the tools, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can help sort and bring gloves. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — same time as before, and I really appreciate the help sorting and the gloves. If you can, just come a little early so we can get set up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far—what are they fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have a fresh update yet, but I’m still gathering the details. I’ll let you know as soon as I know what’s first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’m still piecing it together too, so just let me know when you hear what they’re starting with.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m on it and ready to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam — please start by sorting the repair list by priority, and then we’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll sort the repair list by priority and send you the top items first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here and happy to help—should I check on the time, the drop-off spot, or the supplies list first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s start with the time — I can coordinate around the school schedule. What works best for Thursday evening?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thursday evening sounds good to me — maybe around 6:30, if that works for the school schedule. I can help confirm the exact time with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll swing by the community center this afternoon with a few neighbors in tow.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that sounds great. The community center is on Maple, just past the library; take Oak and turn right at the park.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll take Oak, turn right at the park, and head over to Maple. I’ll bring whoever I can round up for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any update on the repair drive yet? I’m out running errands, so I can pass it along if needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I’m still catching up. What parts do we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure yet — I was just checking in while I’m out. If you hear the list, send it my way and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Late Saturday morning still works for me — I’ll keep spreading the word and signing folks up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll bring the gloves and flashlight. Anything else you want me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you also bring a few trash bags if you can? That should cover it, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you can still help with the repair drive this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — yes, I’m still in for the repair drive. I just need the time and place again so I don’t mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — the repair drive is this week, and I’ll send you the time and place again.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still catching up from the grapevine, but I’m happy to help Saturday morning. What should I bring, and who’s the best person to check in with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — could you bring any basic tools or gloves you have? Please check in with me, and I’ll keep you updated since the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — I’ll bring any basic tools and gloves I have, and I’ll check in with you for updates. Sunday at the community center sounds good; I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m ready with the gloves and flashlight—what should I tackle first when I get there?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great — if you can, start by sorting the donations, and I’ll try to keep the details straight once Mina sends the time and place again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll sort the donations first. If you get the time and place from Mina, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — I’m mostly trying to confirm the timing and who’s coordinating, since I need to line up the logistics. If anything changes, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got the wrench and screwdriver ready, and I’m happy to bring them by once the timing is set. Just let me know who’s coordinating.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — I’m still trying to pin down who’s coordinating, but it sounds like Rosa is the main point of contact. Once the time’s firm, I’ll let you know so you can bring the tools by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’m checking our supplies now, and I’ll let you know what we can spare and what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo — I’m out running errands, so send me the list and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll send you the list as soon as I finish checking, and I’ll note anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still on for Saturday morning, and we could use a few more hands plus a table for tools if anyone has one. If you want, I can help connect you with the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help spread the word and I might be able to bring a table for the tools. Send me the details and I’ll reach out to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be amazing, Mara—thank you. I’ll send the details right over, and a tool table would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m on it and ready to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What should I handle first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Start by checking the supply list and setting out the repair stations. If you want, I can take the lead on organizing the supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still checking on the repair order, but I’ll confirm the first homes as soon as I can. If anyone hears new details, send them my way and I’ll keep the list up to date.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — send any updates my way, and I’ll keep the repair drive details organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll pass along the updates as soon as I get them, especially the first homes and any supply changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll confirm the time, drop-off spot, and that people should bring gloves and any extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — that covers the big pieces. If you hear of any homes needing help, send them to Rosa and I’ll help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do — I’ll send any homes needing help to Rosa and keep an eye out for anything else to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just give me the quickest task, and I’ll do it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — please help with setup right after school at the community center, then stay to pack up when we’re done.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll handle setup after school and stick around to pack up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still able to help with the repair drive this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — I’m still available this week, and I’ll round up a few neighbors for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just checking — you’re still on it for this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far—what are they fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Rosa’s coordinating it all, but I’m not sure what they’re starting with first yet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’m still piecing it together too. If you hear the first repair, let me know?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Start with the gloves and flashlight, then check what supplies we still need and let Ira know the time and place again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check the remaining supplies and remind Ira about the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — thanks, Leo. If anyone else asks, just pass along the time, place, and what we still need.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
